description: Password reset from an account service: Auto-Submitted: auto-generated together with List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post (some services put them on every message); automated, never a story; the token in the link is a placeholder
raw:
Return-Path: <bounces@accounts.example.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 21:40:00 +0000
From: Example Accounts <no-reply@accounts.example.com>
To: alice@example.com
Subject: Reset your password
Message-ID: <reset.88d1@accounts.example.com>
Auto-Submitted: auto-generated
List-Unsubscribe: <https://accounts.example.com/email-preferences>
List-Unsubscribe-Post: List-Unsubscribe=One-Click
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 7bit

Someone asked to reset the password of your account alice@example.com.

To choose a new password, open this link within 30 minutes:
https://accounts.example.com/reset?token=EXAMPLE-NOT-A-REAL-TOKEN

If it was not you, ignore this message.
